sources.title: Bilateral agreement to specify the boundary route from Monte Fitz Roy to Cerro Daudet

sources.title: Argentina Foreign Ministry statement on glacier inventory cartography in Hielos Continentales
sources.license: No explicit reuse license located; citation and restoration instructions retained.
sources.restoration: Fetch the exact official URL and verify SHA-256 5d0e86b6094239c21cff9127c8c831f44c05ec8146c13459cf329a3ee996f017 (43,866 bytes) for this retrieval.
sources.territorial_meaning: Argentina says its 2018 inventory in this zone used official cartography predating the 1998 agreement and that inclusion does not prejudge pending demarcation.

sources.title: IANIGLA National Glacier Inventory, distribution and characteristics of Argentine glaciers
sources.license: No explicit reuse license located; citation and restoration instructions retained.

sources.territorial_meaning: The official summary defines Andes del Sur de la Patagonia as 45–54°S and describes the Southern Patagonian Ice Field as a physical ice field, with an area estimate and Argentine portion.
